description: Omit model or use rules for the existing yes_no, choice and scale rule engine with probability, confidence and action. Use model clef only when enabled for noul, choice and score questions with instructions and criteria. Model calls send state to the configured inference machine, return no action or rule trace, and share a single slot. Default model limits: 8 KiB, 4 questions, 8 choices, 2 calls/minute and 20/UTC day per IP, 300/UTC day globally. No queue or retries. Refusals use 429 or 503 and may carry Retry-After. state holds the facts. For rules, each rule is {"if": condition, "weight": number}, where a condition tests a field of state with eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, in, exists, prefix or contains, combined with any and not. Request and answer bodies are not stored by this API. Model quota counters and aggregates are stored. The full format is at https://aisense.no/free-public-api-decide-api-endpoint. No API key, no account and no sign up: call it directly.

model.description: Optional. rules (default), or a configured model such as clef. Unknown models are refused.

questions.description: 1 to 64 named rule questions, or up to 4 model questions under the default model limits.

state.description: The facts the rules test, or the input sent to the selected model.

name: decide
title: Decide from rules or a model
